rationale: Review started 2026-11-10T06:54:52Z and ended 2026-11-10T07:05:36Z (UTC). I re-hashed jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11957.txt and EO_13241.txt (both match, as do all source fingerprints), confirmed the spans, and read EO 11957 (42 FR 3295, signed January 13, 1977) in full, confirming identity: Sec. 1 sets the officers who act as Secretary of Agriculture when both the Secretary and Deputy Secretary are unavailable, and Sec. 2 revokes EO 11793, performed on signing; there is no own-terms end. EO 13241 Sec. 4 (signed December 18, 2001, 66 FR 66258) states 'Executive Order 11957 of January 13, 1977, is hereby revoked', unqualified and reaching the whole order, and replaces it with a new succession order. The OFR catalog note naming EO 13240 as a revoking order is a misattribution: the held EO 13240 is a designation of GRECO under the International Organizations Immunities Act and does not mention EO 11957; it has the same date and does not affect the status. A cruden number search found EO 11957 cited only by EO 13241 (FR, APP and GPO copies) and the 1989 codification, whose in-force snapshot predates the 2001 revocation; the U.S. Code and eCFR searches had 0 hits and I found no revival. The recommended status NO is supported by held sources through 2026-10-14.
